varosity.note: Varosity hosted MCP server: 60+ video, image, voice and music models. Sign in to your Varosity account in the browser on first connection (OAuth), or send a Varosity API key as 'Authorization: Bearer vsk_...' (create one at https://varosity.ai/app/keys/api-keys). Generations spend prepaid Varosity credits or the user's own provider keys; each result reports the remaining balance.
